card.text: The black hole at the centre of the galaxy M87, 6.5 billion solar masses, whose shadow the EHT imaged in 2017.

sources.label: EHT Collaboration 2019 (M87 Paper I)
sources.quote: The Shadow of the Supermassive Black Hole

introduction.text: M87* sits at the heart of the giant elliptical galaxy M87, 16.8 million parsecs away. In 2019 the Event Horizon Telescope showed its shadow inside a ring of light.

sources.label: EHT Collaboration 2019 (M87 Paper I)
sources.quote: adopt a distance to M87 of 16.8
